subject: Cognitive Science
title: Choice Overload
description: A short lesson to help you apply Choice Overload.

hook.text: A store offers 24 jams for tasting. Another offers 6. The 6-jam table sells ten times more. Less was more.

buildup.text: Choice overload: too many options paralyze decision-making and reduce satisfaction with the final pick.

discovery.text: Sheena Iyengar's jam study showed that abundance creates anxiety. Every option you skip feels like a loss.

twist.text: It doesn't always apply. Experts handle more choices than novices, and desire for variety reduces the effect.

climax.text: Good design reduces choices: curated defaults, categories, and recommendations fight the paralysis.

punchline.text: More options can mean fewer decisions.

quiz.question: What is choice overload?
options: Too many options reducing decision quality and satisfaction
